senderMailbox.description: Mailbox the message is sent from. Must be a mailbox the app registration is allowed to send as.

recipients.description: To addresses. Single address, or several separated by a comma.

cc.description: CC addresses, comma separated. Leave empty to omit.

bcc.description: BCC addresses, comma separated. Leave empty to omit.

replyTo.description: Reply-To addresses, comma separated. These do not receive the message.

subject.description: Subject line. The plugin rejects subjects longer than 255 characters.

bodyHtml.description: HTML body. The plugin sanitises this before sending — scripts and style blocks are stripped.

attachments.description: Knobs for the demo attachment generator; a real process would use resource IDs from the Documenten API or an upload task.

includeSmallFile.description: Attach a small text file of a few hundred bytes.

largeFileSizeKb.description: Size of a generated filler attachment in KB. 0 disables it. The plugin chooses inline vs. upload session per message: any single attachment over 2 MB, or a total over 2 MB, sends all of them through the upload session.

delivery.description: Written by the process after the send task completes.

status.description: SENT once the plugin action returned without error.

sentAt.description: UTC timestamp of the moment the process recorded the result.

contentId.description: Temporary resource storage ID that held the HTML body.

attachmentIds.description: Comma separated temporary resource storage IDs that were attached.
